hero.desc: Independent collective. Focused on club culture and atmosphere. Serious sound without labels.

manifesto.label: 01 — Manifesto
manifesto.title: Music as ritual
manifesto.body: FADER is born as a collective dedicated to underground electronic music in Alicante. We don't chase trends or labels. We seek atmosphere, progressive tension and sound that transforms.
points: Club culture as a space for community

sessions.comingSoonDesc: We'll announce the next event soon. Line-up and date to be confirmed.

descriptions.LITN: LITN is a project centered on deep techno, with selections that move between the hypnotic and the dark. Its sound is characterized by atmospheric layers, deep bass and a musical narrative that builds progressive tension. A regular resident at FADER events.
descriptions.Cristian Camilo: Cristian Camilo explores hypnotic techno with a minimalist and immersive approach. His sets combine underground rhythms, dense textures and progressions that keep the audience in a trance state. A fundamental part of the FADER collective.
descriptions.RUISUK: RUISUK is a project centered on techno with a selection that mixes the industrial and the hypnotic. FADER resident, his sets are characterized by punchy rhythms and dense atmospheres that build a sonic journey without concessions.

origen.title: Origins
origen.body: From our beginnings we have strived to create an intimate experience and build a solid proposal for our community.

enfoque.title: Musical focus
enfoque.body: Our identity is born from techno and minimal, exploring different branches of house without losing our essence. We are drawn to hypnotic, deep and elegant sounds, always driven by a solid groove that connects with the dancefloor.

experiencia.title: Club experience
experiencia.body: Every event is designed from scratch. Lights, visuals, schedules and atmosphere are conceived as part of a single experience, where music is the axis that connects everything. We understand the dancefloor as a meeting space, where sound, darkness and the environment favor a real connection between those who share it.

comunidad.title: Community
comunidad.body: FADER is not just a music collective but a community where we combine tastes for art and sound seeking to connect people.
